name: What types of damage can be repaired on wood fence panels?

mainEntity.name: What types of damage can be repaired on wood fence panels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many types of damage to wood fence panels can be repaired. This includes replacing broken or missing pickets, fixing loose or wobbly posts, repairing sections affected by rot or insect damage, and correcting leaning fences. Minor cosmetic issues like splinters or small cracks can often be addressed as well. Extensive damage, especially to the entire fence structure, might necessitate a partial or full replacement rather than just a repair. Frasheski Construction evaluates the damage to determine the best course of action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairable damage includes broken pickets, loose posts, rot, insect damage, and leaning fences. Extensive structural damage may require replacement.
